description:
### Kizu 2.0.1-beta.20

- Inject third-party emotes into Twitch 31.3.1's actual native model catalog (Lh7a.c), rather than its separate string-alias map.
- Refresh the active native catalog when 7TV, BTTV and FFZ data arrives.
- Retain bare-token autocomplete and add diagnostics for catalog injection failures.
